summary: This Marx lecture closes the status-proof correction named by the Middle-Class Anxiety review while already extending Attention Capture and Religion As Administrative Filter: Jiang grants Marx's alienation diagnosis, rejects economic monocause by putting religion/status before economics, and holds Marxism as a salvation-shaped materialist religion rather than a standalone Marx page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Use value lets maker and receiver recognize each other, while exchange value, specialization, grades, wages, and consumer self-enslavement redirect alienation into money, competition, and private consumption.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Attention Capture page already cites this source in the worker-to-consumer inversion anchor and chronology. No episode read JSON repair is needed.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Capitalism and communism become the same materialist religion when public thought asks about GDP, jobs, inflation, equality, consumption, technology, and education-for-money instead of spiritual condition.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode read already links these materialist-religion marks to the atlas-level reason/replacement-religion anchor.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the Marx layer of the worker-to-consumer inversion. Jiang uses the apple-pie image, specialization as bodily fragmentation, school and wage competition, and consumer slavery to show how alienation that might become collective consciousness is redirected into money, display, debt, and private status pursuit.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Attention owns captured social focus and the worker-to-consumer inversion. Human Heart owns relation and recognition only when the source foregrounds mutual personhood; Power owns money as reality; Game Theory owns explicit status-game incentives.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Record this source as the Marx/status-correction layer named by the 2026-06-19 cluster review. Jiang says capitalism is not explained by economics alone: agriculture, civilization, and industrial capitalism require religion, Protestant anxiety, God, and status before money becomes proof. This strengthens the held seed against becoming a generic class-economics page.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The Middle-Class Anxiety seed remains a routing rule after PR #1073, not a public page, child page, atlas relation, or new lens-point surface.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public as boundary pressure for replacement religion: Jiang says capitalism and communism are the same materialist religion because both train people to treat economic indicators, consumption, technology, and education-for-money as salvation while ignoring spiritual condition.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Religion As Administrative Filter should not become a general Marx or communism page. It receives the source only where a secular system takes over religion's truth, salvation, office, or operator-selection work.

concept_extensions.boundary_note: Game Theory owns payoff/rule/status-board reset. Power owns capital and financialization; Mass Society owns scale; Prediction would need split dated claims before any ledger use.

Jiang says communism plus capitalism makes school, money, depression, suicide, and lost childhood into an evil religion for children.

new_lens_seeds.title: Materialist Religion As False Salvation
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A secular system becomes religious when it makes economics, science, technology, equality, consumption, or education-for-money the thing that names salvation, organizes attention, and tells people what suffering means, while leaving the spiritual condition untouched.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This source links Marxism, capitalism, communism, technocracy, AI, and education-for-money into one replacement-religion pattern, and it can compare with existing Reason Becomes A Religion and Communist Specter pressure. It should remain a seed because Religion As Administrative Filter and the atlas relation already carry the public boundary.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a seed and routing rule. The public atlas already has the reason/replacement-religion relation, and a separate page would need a broader review across Reason, Marx, Communism, AI technocracy, and education.

new_lens_seeds.title: Revolution As Status-Game Reset
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A revolution releases energy by destroying old elites, reopening blocked status transfer, and resetting the game board, not because a single economic law of history guarantees progress.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The source connects Marx's failed prophecy, elite overproduction, gerontocratic blockage, financialization, and Soviet/Chinese/French revolutionary examples. It could later compare class, elite, gerontocracy, and game-theory pages.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold for later concept-cluster review. One Marx lecture is not enough to create a public revolution/status-game page.

chronology_notes.note: This 2025-05-29 lecture is the explicit Marx correction layer after the 2025-03-27 Protestant anxiety and 2025-05-06 Dutch middle-class sources: religion/status precede economic monocause, while Marx still supplies the alienation diagnosis that later Attention Capture uses.

The lecture sets up Freud as the next course layer: Marx and Bakunin still treat freedom and happiness as collective, while Freud/psychology will move attention from world and community toward the individual self.

canon_candidates.candidate: Jiang's Marx correction: Marx is powerful because he sees capitalism's alienation and salvation appeal, but wrong because economics is not the deepest cause; religion, status, God, and shared meaning precede the economic story.
canon_candidates.reason: Strong candidate for a later canon/model note, but it should be reviewed with Protestant anxiety, Dutch status proof, Communist Specter, and replacement-religion sources before promotion.
